longs.thesis: Fiscal Q4 blowout - revenue $3.86B, +84% y/y, beat $3.48B consensus; non-GAAP EPS $4.43 vs $3.19 expected. Raised FY27 guidance on AI/cloud infrastructure demand and the completed ZT Systems integration.
Q3 EPS $0.83 vs $0.56 expected; revenue $707.4M, +84% y/y vs $599.7M expected; raised full-year 2026 sales growth guidance to 72-75%; order backlog $1.9B, +40.5% y/y.
Partial retracement of Monday's -4.27% drop on the board's investigation into CEO Jensen Huang; options flow aggressively bullish into the dip, ~75% of Monday's options premium in calls.
FQ2 net bookings $1.60B slightly missed and FY27 guidance cut - yet shares up on GTA 6 momentum: preloads began, 7M+ preorders generating $750M+, game unlocks Nov 19.

shorts.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue beat and raised guidance, but margin compression and heavy AI investment spending overwhelmed the print. Gapping down hard on a beat.

Record Q3 revenue $267.8M (+73% y/y, beat ~$258M) and backlog up 52% to $3.57B, but the loss widened to -$0.12/share vs -$0.07 expected, and the first Neutron launch was pushed to no earlier than 2027.
Extending its slump after an unexpected Q3 loss and narrowed full-year revenue guidance.
